title: 12 Best Sunset Bars in Koh Samui (2026)
description: The best sunset bars in Koh Samui — curated from Reddit reviews. Air Bar, Nikki Beach, Woobar, Jahn, ARKbar & more.

venues.name: Air Bar Samui
venues.address: 295 Moo 3, Taling Ngam, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84140
venues.verdict: The undisputed king of Koh Samui sunsets — a clifftop terrace perched above the Gulf of Thailand with panoramic views of the Five Islands.

venues.name: Nikki Beach Koh Samui
venues.address: 96/3 Lipa Noi, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84140
venues.verdict: The iconic global beach club brand meets Koh Samui's best west-coast sunset — pool parties, DJs, and golden-hour cocktails.

venues.name: Woobar at W Koh Samui
venues.address: 4/1 Moo 1, Maenam, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84330
venues.verdict: The most design-forward bar on Koh Samui — a contemporary pool deck with panoramic northeast views toward Koh Phangan.

venues.name: Jahn at Conrad Koh Samui
venues.address: 49/8-9 Hillcrest Road, Taling Ngam, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84140
venues.verdict: The most romantic sunset dinner spot on Koh Samui — a hilltop terrace with five-island views and royal Thai cuisine.

venues.name: The Cliff Bar & Grill
venues.address: 124/2 Tambon Maret, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84310
venues.verdict: A dramatic cliffside setting between Lamai and Chaweng — stunning ocean views with more accessible pricing than the resort bars.

venues.name: STAR at Silavadee
venues.address: 208/66 Tambon Maret, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84310
venues.verdict: A rooftop chill-out perched above Silavadee's infinity pool — the most romantic twilight bar on the island.

venues.name: ARKbar Beach Club
venues.address: 4/1 Chaweng Beach Rd, Bo Put, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84320
venues.verdict: Koh Samui's most famous beach party bar — cheap drinks, fire shows, and a vibe that runs from sunset to sunrise.

venues.name: Cape Away Beach Bar
venues.verdict: A hidden gem at the end of a dead-end road in Maenam — the kind of authentic beach bar that feels like discovering a secret.

venues.name: The Sunset
venues.address: Bo Put, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84320
venues.verdict: A relaxed beachfront bar near Fisherman's Village — the sweet spot between Koh Samui's budget and luxury extremes.

venues.name: Tembo Beach Club & Resort
venues.address: 23/2 Bangrak Beach, Bo Put, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84320
venues.verdict: A stylish beach club on Bangrak Beach with a pool, great music, and views toward Big Buddha — the mid-range sweet spot.

venues.name: Beryl Bar
venues.address: Taling Ngam, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84140
venues.verdict: The best-value sunset bar on Koh Samui's west coast — local prices, direct sunset views, and zero pretension.

venues.name: Hush Bar
venues.address: Bo Put, Koh Samui, Surat Thani 84320
venues.verdict: The after-sunset bar — where you go when the golden hour crowd disperses and you're ready for craft cocktails in a more intimate setting.
